scope: Working-tree balance candidate; 48 mirrored samples before and 48 after, no claim of faction win rates.
limits: 18 military cells per side; 60 seconds of production, deployed together; no reinforcements or towers.
No upgrades, relics, construction times or economic buildings. L3 means producer levels only.
Income requirements include unit prices and Undead upkeep; currency totals are not treated as equivalent.
Two seeds, mirrored sides, 90 seconds per fight. These samples do not establish general faction win rates.
